title: Measure word type coverage
description: Reads a lane ledger, its sidecar and a pinned frequency list and reports where every word type stands (Expected, Unverified, Disposition, Open or Lost), what is still Open by mechanism, and the three Done tests. It reads and never writes, takes saved checks and dispositions from the Motif store, and is not the report verb's coverage kind, the share of words the parser analysed.
